multihop.note: The hop taken was internal to this wave: read against PMID 42395553's gamma-H2AX result, which is what produced the non-monotonicity finding. No external hop was required.

corpus_crossquery.query: Do CLAIM 009 (mitochondrial/redox, in observation) or CLAIM 034 (counter-direction) already carry a ROS-rescue result for a Wwox-null system?
corpus_crossquery.finding: Both claims exist and neither carries this one. The NAC rescue in Wwox-null MEFs is adjacent to CLAIM 009's redox axis and does not resolve its tension with CLAIM 034, because it is a fibroblast culture result with no neural or in vivo arm. Logged as a lead in the analysis note, not proposed as a claim.

retraction_check.result: No retraction, no expression of concern, no erratum. Article type 'Journal Article'. The token 'retract' occurs once in the JATS, inside the reference list.

source_artifacts.note: Europe PMC JATS for PMC10613160, 180,204 bytes. The JATS inserts spaces inside the genotype token, so the body reads 'Wwox -/- MEFs' with the minus signs separated; quotes carry that spacing.

verbatim_locators.source_fulltext_indexed_evidence: Europe PMC JATS, 180,204 bytes; Abstract, Introduction, Materials and methods, Results, Discussion and all figure legends present in the body.
verbatim_locators.abstract_anchoring_waived: Stated per entry. Where an entry draws on the abstract it says so in its anchor; every entry is matched against the declared artifact as a whole.
verbatim_locators.note: COVERAGE: whole article read, including Materials and methods and every figure legend. NOT INSPECTED: Supplementary Figures 1-9 and Supplementary Table 1, a separate PDF not fetched -- so the cell-cycle fractions, the Hprt mutation assay, the microsatellite electropherograms, the HEK293T and human dermal fibroblast knockdown results, the MG132/p27 work, the MDM2 binding and the p21 promoter methylation are carried only by the running text. CONTROL GENOTYPE FLAGGED: the comparator throughout most figures is Wwox +/- , not wild type; Wwox +/+ appears only in Figures 2b, 4d, 5g-i and 6a-e. Nothing in this paper licenses a statement about heterozygotes versus wild type.

entries.proposition: THE DIRECTIONAL FACT THAT COLLIDES WITH THE 2026 PREPRINT AND IS THE BATCH'S MOST USEFUL SYNTHESIS: LOSS of WWOX raises the same DNA-damage marker that ADDED WWOX raises in the preprint. One marker, two opposite perturbations, same direction of change.
